title: Heart Necklace
desc: Individually 3D printed and hand-finished heart necklace created for PublicPixels collectors. Approximately 2.5cm in size with a semi-translucent resin heart that shifts subtly under different lighting. Small surface variations are part of its handmade character.
notes: Chain length typically reaches the collarbone when worn.
Packaged in a protective box with cushioning for safe delivery.
material: 3D printed resin with a semi-translucent finish, paired with a lightweight metal chain.
shipping: Each piece is made to order. Production and shipping times may vary depending on my studio location and workload.
care: Handle gently to preserve the clarity. Keep away from high heat and harsh chemicals.
